messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY BLOCKED] Canary deploy for release/v2.8.1 (commit a1b2c3d) to environment=staging-canary blocked by CI gate. Failing checks: integration-parallel-3 (x2), lint, e2e-flaky-7. Auto-fallback to previous model variant not configured for this route. CI details: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/68234 :warning:
Ajay: ah, saw the alert. which tests are red? can someone paste the failing logs? :thinking_face:
Lina: integration-parallel-3 shows 2 flakes hitting the same test shard, stacktrace points to timeout in shard 7. small repro in logs: `TimeoutError: step exceeded 120s`
Maria: lint failure is a single file change in sdk/serialize.js — should be quick to fix but not for a hotfix patch ideally.
SRE-Bot: Note: change window open until 18:00 PST. Any rollback requires manual approval from oncall and Eng leads.
Ajay: given the flakes, i'd prefer to rerun the specific jobs before pin/rollback. can we rerun the parallel shard?
DevOps: we can target rerun for these jobs. command:
```
/ci rerun --job=integration-parallel-3 --shard=7 --attempts=2
```
DevOps: also suggest disabling the flaky shard split to isolate for now.
Lina: if rerun passes, we can proceed with canary. if it fails again, propose pinning to release/v2.8.0 for canary and retry RC pipeline in off-peak.
Maria: i'll open a tiny PR for the lint fix; ETA 20 mins. does canary need lint to pass? (i assume yes as CI gate includes it)
Ajay: yes, CI gate requires lint + all integration shards green. so we need both.
deploy-bot: [ACTION REQUIRED] Deploy paused. Waiting for: 1) integration-parallel-3 rerun result, 2) lint PR merge, 3) manual confirmation to resume. To resume: `@deploy-bot resume <thread_ts>` by an eng-release lead.
SRE-Bot: Oncall paging enabled if this persists past 10m.
Lina: I'll monitor the reruns. tagging @Ajay for release decision if reruns fail.
Ajay: got it. i'll be standby. if reruns fail twice, approve pin to v2.8.0 for canary and schedule rc rerun after change window.
Maria: PR submitted: https://git.redwood.example/pulls/4721 — lint fix. linking it here.
DevOps: rerun started for integration-parallel-3 (shard 7).
deploy-bot: [UPDATE] integration-parallel-3 (shard 7) rerun #1: FAILURE (timeout). rerun #2 queued.
Lina: ugh. rerun #1 timed out too. can we increase timeout briefly?
DevOps: we can bump timeout to 300s for the shard for a one-off rerun. applying now.
DevOps: rerun #2 started with 300s timeout.
Ajay: if rerun #2 fails, execute pin plan and notify infra for rollback window.
deploy-bot: [UPDATE] rerun #2: SUCCESS. integration-parallel-3 now PASSED.
Maria: lint PR merged. CI re-triggered for full gate.
deploy-bot: [UPDATE] CI gate re-evaluated: all checks green. Canary deploy can resume. To proceed, an eng-release lead must run `@deploy-bot resume 2012346789`.
Ajay: resuming now. @deploy-bot resume 2012346789
deploy-bot: [RESUME] Canary deploy for release/v2.8.1 to staging-canary resumed by Ajay. Starting rollout step 2/4.
Lina: monitoring metrics and canary traces. will report within 10m. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
SRE-Bot: Reminder: if any downstream latency spike >2x baseline, auto-rollback threshold will trigger.
Ajay: thanks everyone. action items: - DevOps: follow up on flaky shard root cause - Lina: monitor canary for 30m - Maria: watch post-release checks for lint regressions - Ajay: confirm final promote or pin if anomalies.
Lina: noted. closing thread after stable canary. :white_check_mark:
